title.zh: 将南甘马粦省 Baao 市镇 Sagrada 描笼涯的 Baao 国立中学的 Sagrada 附属校分离，改设为独立的 Nonito Paz Arroyo 纪念国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Baao National High School - Sagrada Annex in Barangay Sagrada, Municipality of Baao, Province of Camarines Sur From the Baao National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Nonito Paz Arroyo Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Baao National High School - Sagrada Annex in Barangay Sagrada, Municipality of Baao, Province of Camarines Sur From the Baao National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Nonito Paz Arroyo Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Sagrada của Trường Trung học Baao Quốc gia tại Barangay Sagrada, Đô thị Baao, Tỉnh Camarines Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Baao Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Nonito Paz Arroyo Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Sagrada ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Baao แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Sagrada เทศบาล Baao จังหวัด Camarines Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Baao แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Nonito Paz Arroyo แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Sagrada, Sekolah Menengah Baao Nasional di Barangay Sagrada, Kotamadya Baao, Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Baao Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Memorial Nonito Paz Arroyo Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Sagrada, Sekolah Menengah Baao Kebangsaan di Barangay Sagrada, Perbandaran Baao, Wilayah Camarines Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Baao Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Memorial Nonito Paz Arroyo Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Baao National High School - Sagrada Annex in Barangay Sagrada, Municipality of Baao, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby separated from the Baao National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Nonito Paz Arroyo Memorial National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Baao National High School - Sagrada Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Nonito Paz Arroyo Memorial National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Nonito Paz Arroyo Memorial National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriatbns of the Baao National High School - Sagrada Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the p urpose of thiB Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
